whyItMatters: Runtime.getRuntime().exec(payload) passes its argument to command execution in java, so untrusted input reaching it becomes command injection.
actions: Replace Runtime.getRuntime().exec(payload) with ProcessBuilder with a command list, passing untrusted data as separate arguments, never interpolated into a command string.
If a shell is required, restrict the command to a fixed allowlist and validate every argument against it.
Re-run the scan and confirm no Runtime.getRuntime().exec(payload) call remains reachable from untrusted input.
verification: Rescan shows no Runtime.getRuntime().exec(payload) reachable from untrusted input, and command tests with metacharacter input execute safely.
